name: Design the mechanism reset
text_content:
Type: process

After dinner's first quarter, after the first full year, then annually at the house review nearest dinner's anniversary. Every mechanism read against its record, cost, and buy; continue, change by versioned decision, or end. Lifts the first-quarter freeze; resets the parameters (P39).

Filed by Session 4 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhjr. Reasoning lives on the S4 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

Extended. Session 9 gives the reset its diagnostic agenda: it opens on the Maitre d's seat's load reading from nine listed inputs (I5, A5), reads the year's evidence lines side by side mode by mode, takes any mode present on two consecutive quarterly lines after a fix as a mechanism question and decides whether the mechanism or the mode was wrong before naming a second fix, reads any designation held by one person every service as a question about the seat's hours and the designation's rule, converts the mentor pool from the leads at the first reset, and re-sets the recurrence thresholds and the career conversation's length as parameters. The first reset also opens on the held list of every diagnostic line raised inside the first-quarter freeze (A9).
